title: mason-hook failures are always silent exit 0
body: The hook runs inside other people's Claude Code sessions on every Read/Edit/Write. Any nonzero exit, stderr noise, or malformed stdout would disrupt sessions repo-wide, so every failure path (malformed stdin, missing store, state-file write errors, unexpected exceptions) must resolve to exit 0 with no output. Never add a failure mode that surfaces to the session; log nothing. Also keep the hook fast (~100ms budget): no fast-glob sweeps, no co-change computation, no network.
